scope: Read-only source/protocol/dependency inspection and pure mock/unit tests. No Torch import, actual WindowsBackend/WindowsJob execution, native child, model, real acceptance or science run.
decision: No blocking finding in this bounded pre-freeze engineering review; real acceptance remains unexecuted by this reviewer.

independent_tests.interpreter: local activation venv; executable path intentionally omitted
independent_tests.scope: Pure mocks/temporary inert files only. Worker branch tests patch backend, Popen, preparation and hard exits; case drivers patch all OS work; acceptance tests patch run_case or stop at unsupported-platform gate. No test calls prepare_workload or real child creation.

reviewed_contracts: Fixed six-case order: healthy32, healthy64 without cap, CPU-progress timeout, busy actual-worker private threshold64, exact prehandshake exit37, exact nonce-named ModuleNotFoundError/exit38.

Nonce-bound actual interpreter is authenticated via unchanged retained handle/creation/Toolhelp ancestry/job membership before native creation and site/Torch release. Prehandshake control explicitly leaves actual interpreter identity unavailable.

Native cmd launches with direct fixed argv, shell false, anonymous stdin PIPE, DEVNULL stdout/stderr, close_fds true and CREATE_NO_WINDOW. Parent checks authenticated sender, retained native PID/creation, direct parent, live job membership, native image path and frozen image bytes. Native process has no self-authenticated nonce receipt; report states this boundary.

Static workload code has one finite1024square float32 CPU forward/backward/SGD step, declared2/2 Torch threads and raw native thread count. Busy stage only calls fixed-output torch.mm in no_grad with finite monotonic backstop; no additional optimizer/backward operation appears.

Held post-import/single-update/preallocated-buffer baseline and manual-allocation plateau use self-before/parent/self-after identity/time/memory brackets. Private threshold is actual retained interpreter baseline plus48MiB, checked after64MiB held allocation and one busy matmul; same64MiB healthy case is uncapped control.

Sampling includes busy interval boundaries and requires max gap0.5s; timeout requires native worker CPU progress0.25s. Live actual/native identities are checked immediately before whole-job termination, and cap latency is bounded1s from allocated self-before to termination return.

Stage waits clamp to case20s/suite120s. Cleanup is capped4s and remaining budget; errors cannot pass. Job/retained-handle close errors and late final close set failed; every completed case and suite reports are retained. Existing output directory is not reused.

Freeze validates new source/test, protocol, frozen dependency, launcher and native executable hashes plus declaration/freeze chronology. Normal report fields publish executable basenames/hashes, not absolute paths; known local roots/executable paths are removed from public_error strings.
limitations_and_open_gates: Review and27mock passes are engineering source/unit evidence only; actual Torch import, version, thread behavior, CPU progress, native identity, memory deltas, deadlines and cleanup require root's one frozen real suite.
Worker native_cpu_seconds establishes sampled worker CPU progress. Parent sampler CPU overhead is not separately measured and must not be inferred.

If case/suite budget is already exhausted, verified cleanup may return cleanup_error; KILL_ON_JOB_CLOSE is then attempted in finally. Such a case fails and cannot be described as successfully verified cleanup.

Freeze pins the venv launch executable bytes. Runtime interpreter executable basename/hash is recorded by the authenticated handshake but is not independently compared to an additional pre-frozen base-interpreter hash.
Known-path replacement is not a universal arbitrary-path scrubber. Root should inspect saved real receipts/errors before publication for paths outside the known workspace/executables.

Sampled private threshold is neither a hard memory ceiling nor an arbitrary-descendant memory cap; manual ctypes payload is bounded64MiB while Torch/runtime allocation is distinct. Sampling is not continuous peak-memory evidence.

Native pipe may reach EOF after worker termination; whole-job success does not identify the exclusive per-descendant death cause. Configured Torch thread limits/raw count do not prove exact concurrent kernel worker ownership.
No historical parent RSS measurement is rehabilitated, and no cost/final-quality/compression/production gate is upgraded by this engineering review.
